title: 1974 Coyame crash and CIA-directed retrieval plan
summary: UAPGerb tells of 1974 Coyame crash and CIA-directed retrieval plan, about 1974 at Mexico (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I love the 1974 Coyame New Mexico crash. There's not a ton of supporting evidence, but the story there if true is very very disturbing and also pretty interesting just the way that apparently the DEB report is a CIA directed like logistics plan like the OGA would do to uh gather rapid reaction teams and assets to go retrieve the CF craft
According to the leaked report that surfaced in the '90s, the whole Mexican team ends up dead, and the mystery object is airlifted out by US forces.
tellings.difference: Adds a mid-air collision, says the whole Mexican team died and that US forces airlifted the object out, and dates the report's surfacing to the 1990s.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same 1974 Coyame crash and the US retrieval described in a leaked report.
